app.loopbackFooter: Desktop controls communicate with WokCore over loopback HTTP.

core.heading: WokCore health

missing.title: WokCore not installed
missing.summary: Install WokCore or register its trusted installation before starting local routing.

stopped.title: WokCore stopped
stopped.summary: The desktop app is available, but local routing stays offline until WokCore starts.

starting.title: WokCore starting
starting.summary: WokCore is preparing its local management service.

running.title: WokCore running
running.summary: WokCore is ready to accept local client traffic.

draining.title: WokCore draining
draining.summary: Existing requests are finishing. New work remains offline until draining completes.

authorizationRequired.title: WokRouter authorization required
authorizationRequired.summary: Authorize this desktop client before it can inspect or control the WokCore service.

incompatible.title: WokCore update required
incompatible.summary: The installed WokCore management API is not compatible with this WokRouter version.

invalidRuntime.title: WokCore runtime invalid
invalidRuntime.summary: WokRouter could not verify the configured WokCore installation or runtime response.

statusUnavailable.title: WokCore status unavailable
statusUnavailable.summary: WokRouter could not confirm whether WokCore is available. Your configuration has not been changed.

core.actionNote: Closing this window never stops WokCore.
core.developmentActionNote: This development WokCore is managed by the IDE.

actionFailure.summary: The service state was not assumed to have changed. Check its status or safely try the action again.

install.title: WokCore setup
install.otherProcess: WokCore operation continues in another process
install.otherProcessSummary: The trusted installation is still in progress. WokRouter will reconnect when it finishes.
install.unavailableSummary: WokRouter could not begin or recover the verified setup operation. Your local configuration was not assumed to have changed.
install.preflightSummary: WokRouter is checking for an operation it can safely resume before starting installation.

update.title: WokCore update
update.confirmBody: WokCore may briefly stop while the verified update is installed. Active requests can defer the update safely.
update.checkUnavailableSummary: WokRouter could not verify whether an update is available. The current WokCore remains unchanged.
update.startFailedSummary: WokRouter could not begin or recover a verified update operation. The current WokCore was not assumed to have changed.
update.retryRequirement: A fresh signed check and confirmation are required before retrying.

result.installed: The verified WokCore operation completed successfully.
result.updated: Verified WokCore {{targetVersion}} is installed and ready.
result.current: The fresh signed check reports WokCore {{currentVersion}} is already current.
result.activeRequests_one: {{formattedCount}} active request remains. WokCore is still serving it; try the update again later.
result.activeRequests_other: {{formattedCount}} active requests remain. WokCore is still serving them; try the update again later.
result.rolledBack: The WokCore update failed and the previous version was restored.

recovery.diagnosticsUnavailable: Diagnostics are unavailable because this WokCore runtime does not provide diagnostic events.
recovery.offlineDescription: This guide uses only WokRouter's validated local operation record and does not call WokCore diagnostics.
recovery.stepCheck: Check WokCore status with the local desktop control.
recovery.stepRestart: If WokCore is missing, stopped, or invalid, restart WokRouter and follow the verified setup action shown for that status.
recovery.stepRetry: Retry the update only after WokCore is running.
recovery.checkFailed: WokRouter could not refresh local status. Restart WokRouter before continuing recovery.
recovery.actionNote: Closing this window never cancels a WokCore operation.

monitoring.title: Operation monitoring
monitoring.unavailableSummary: WokRouter could not reconcile trusted operation progress. Reconnect monitoring before starting or monitoring WokCore setup and updates.
monitoring.reconnectNote: This only reconnects read-only operation monitoring.

statusRecovery.setupTitle: WokCore setup completed, but status is unavailable
statusRecovery.setupSummary: WokRouter could not confirm the new WokCore status. Check the trusted status again without repeating installation.
statusRecovery.updateTitle: WokCore update completed, but status is unavailable
statusRecovery.updateSummary: WokRouter could not confirm the new WokCore status. Check the trusted status again without repeating the update.

providers.changesNotApplied: Provider changes were not assumed to have applied. Refresh and try again.
providers.addDescription: Choose a built-in adapter, then assign a local routing name.
providers.accountsDescription: Secret values are sent directly to WokCore and never returned to this interface.
providers.secretFailure: The credential was not assumed to have changed. Check the account and try again.

indexPhase.idle: Session indexes are up to date

sessions.emptyDetail: WokCore will surface local Codex, Claude, and Gemini sessions as their indexes become available.
sessions.selectDetail: Message bodies stay unloaded until you choose a session.
sessions.messageAccessDetail: This WokCore build does not advertise session message access.

usage.heading: Local usage
usage.emptyDetail: Totals will appear here after WokCore indexes local usage records.

diagnostics.exportFailed: The diagnostic archive could not be saved. No destination was reported as successful.
diagnostics.emptyDetail: Recent bounded diagnostic events will appear here when available.

errors.downloadFailed: WokCore could not be downloaded. Check the network and try again.
errors.invalidInstallState: The configured WokCore installation could not be trusted. Review the installation before retrying.
errors.invalidManifest: The WokCore release information was invalid. Nothing was installed.
errors.invalidSignature: The WokCore signature could not be verified. Nothing untrusted was installed.
errors.incompatibleManifest: This WokCore release is not compatible with the current system.
errors.artifactSizeMismatch: The downloaded WokCore package was incomplete. Nothing was installed.
errors.artifactHashMismatch: The downloaded WokCore package did not pass verification. Nothing was installed.
errors.invalidArchive: The WokCore package could not be opened safely. Nothing was installed.
errors.unsafeInstallLocation: WokCore cannot be installed in the configured location safely.
errors.installInProgress: Another WokCore installation is still in progress. Try again after it finishes.
errors.installFailed: WokCore could not be installed. The current configuration was left unchanged.
errors.installRecordFailed: WokCore was installed, but its trusted installation record could not be saved.
errors.startFailed: WokCore was installed but could not be started. You can safely try again.
errors.authorizationFailed: WokRouter could not be authorized to manage WokCore. You can safely try again.
errors.updateUnavailable: No verified WokCore update is currently available.
errors.updateVerificationFailed: The WokCore update could not be verified. No untrusted update was installed.
errors.activeRequestsRemain: WokCore is still serving active requests. Try the update again later.
errors.rolledBack: The WokCore update failed and the previous version was restored.
errors.updateInstallFailed: The WokCore update could not be completed safely. Review diagnostics and try again.
errors.recoveryRequired: WokCore could not recover automatically. Open diagnostics when available, or use the offline recovery steps before retrying.
errors.operationInProgress: Another WokCore operation is still in progress. Wait for it to finish.
errors.invalidProgress: WokRouter could not verify the operation progress. Check WokCore status before retrying.
errors.unknown: WokRouter could not complete the operation safely. Check WokCore status and try again.

common.localStateRecovery: WokRouter did not assume any local state. Check WokCore and try again.
